newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NORTHERNS WIN TOSS, FREE STATE BAT FIRST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NORTHERNS WIN TOSS, FREE STATE BAT FIRST.

text.p: Northern Transvaal captain Mark Davis won the toss and asked Free State to bat first on the opening day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match at Centurion Park on Friday.
Northern Transvaal - Andre Seymore, Mark Davis (captain), Roy Pienaar, Richie Richardson, Mike Rindel, Dan van Zyl, Steve Elworthy, Ivan Pistorius, Pierre Joubert, Rudi Bryson, Deon Kuis.

Free State - Deon Jordaan, Gerhardus Liebenberg, Boeta Dippenaar, Louis Wilkinson (captain), Kosie Venter, Chris Craven, Franklyn Stephenson, Philip Radley, Bradley Player, Hermann Bakkes, Sarel Cilliers.
